caption: The drawing depicts a wooden roll-top desk with a reddish-brown finish positioned on a plain, light tan background. The desk has three large drawers with brass handles aligned vertically on the lower half and a pull-out writing surface covered in green material, extending outward above the drawers. Above this writing surface, the roll-top section is open, displaying small vertical compartments and cubbyholes with arched tops, as well as several miniature drawers with round, gold-colored knobs. On top of the roll-top compartment, three additional rectangular drawers, also finished in reddish-brown and with small brass knobs, are depicted. The base of the desk has carved legs and apron with curved cutouts. In the bottom right corner, the name “Bernard Krieger” is signed. There is a white, irregularly-shaped mark or faded area beneath the desk.
title: Secretary
